title: The cover focus picker moves the course home's cover

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19, on /journeys/the-business-of-community-101/learn with the Manage panel open: "Focus picker isn't working".

detail: The Manage panel's Cover image picker saves journey_plans.cover_focus, and the sales page (/journeys/<slug>) positions its cover with it. The course home drew the same photo with no position, so it always cropped to the centre: an author dragging the focus point on /journeys/<slug>/learn saw the preview move and the page stay still. The course home now passes the saved focal point to its cover band.

verify.note: Fails on main: the course home never reads cover_focus.
